description: This file defines the LogicHook class used to manage and execute logic hooks in the SuiteCRM platform, including loading hook files, retrieving hooks for modules, and executing hooks based on events.

classes.name: LogicHook
classes.description: Class providing methods to initialize, load, retrieve, and process logic hooks within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of LogicHook.

methods.name: setBean
methods.description: Sets the bean object for the hook context.

methods.name: getHooksMap
methods.description: Returns the map of loaded hooks.

methods.name: getHooksList
methods.description: Returns the list of scanned hooks.

methods.name: scanHooksDir
methods.description: Scans a directory for hook files and loads hooks defined within them.

methods.name: loadHooks
methods.description: Loads hook definitions for a specific module or application from predefined files.

methods.name: getHooks
methods.description: Retrieves hooks for a module, with optional refresh.

methods.name: call_custom_logic
methods.description: Invokes hooks registered for a specific module and event.

methods.name: process_hooks
methods.description: Processes and executes hook functions based on the provided hook array and event.
